description: This file defines a React component 'MetadataView' and related components for rendering metadata related to test runs, including CI info, git commits, and other properties, with error boundaries and utility functions.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that catches JavaScript errors anywhere in its child component tree, logs those errors, and displays a fallback UI.

classes.name: InnerMetadataView
classes.description: A React functional component that renders specific metadata details including CI info, git commit info, and other properties.

classes.name: CiInfoView
classes.description: A React component that displays CI-related information, including a link to the PR or commit.

classes.name: GitCommitInfoView
classes.description: A React component that displays git commit details, author, timestamp, and optional link.

methods.name: MetadataView
methods.description: Main exported React component that renders the metadata view within an error boundary.

methods.name: isMetadataEmpty
methods.description: Utility function that determines if the provided metadata object contains any meaningful information apart from ignorable keys.
